title: Product Map shape grouping
purpose: Cover the shape-grouping renderer and its drill-down for AC-17001-1 and AC-17001-2.

testCases.description: Rendering the tree emits a product-map tab with shape buckets covering every classified shape plus Unclassified and Business rules.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/product-map.test.js::product-map shape grouping renders one bucket per shape plus Unclassified and Business rules

testCases.description: The shape grouping drills bucket -> REQ (status pill) -> US -> AC using the shared detailsWrap helper.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/product-map.test.js::product-map shape grouping drills bucket to REQ to US to AC with status pill
